description: If a successful derivation of \(c\) has record \(\tau\) consistent with \(B\), and \(d,v\) give a bounded-use reduction of \(B\) to \(C\), the actual syntax substitution \(\operatorname{subst}(d,c)\) has a successful record \(\rho\) consistent with \(C\) and the same output. Every position \(r\) in \(\rho\) satisfies \(r<v(q)\) for some original queried position \(q\) in \(\tau\).
